fullDescription: A high-density, technical dashboard style guide utilizing a 'Ground Truth' dark navy and cyan palette. Designed for real-time monitoring, industrial control, and SaaS audit interfaces. Key features include glassmorphism cards, pixel-grid backgrounds, technical typography (JetBrains Mono), and status-driven color coding (Emerald for health, Rose for critical errors, Amber for warnings). Ideal for data-heavy applications requiring high legibility in low-light environments, such as network operations centers, financial trading platforms, or IoT management systems.

structured.summary: A sophisticated dark-mode design system for technical monitoring, featuring a deep navy base (#020617), vibrant cyan accents (#22d3ee), and highly legible typography for complex data visualization. The layout uses a modular card-based structure with subtle glassmorphism and grid-based alignment.

style.description: The style is 'Industrial-Cyberpunk Minimalist.' It pairs the approachable 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for UI elements with 'JetBrains Mono' for technical data. The color palette is strictly controlled to maintain high contrast while reducing eye strain. Animations are purposeful, utilizing smooth cubic-bezier transitions for hover states and subtle pulses for live indicators.
style.prompt:
Create a UI style based on a dark navy theme. 
- **Core Palette**: Background: `#020617`; Card Surfaces: `#0f172a`; Hover/Highlight Surfaces: `#1e293b`; Primary Accent: `#22d3ee` (Cyan); Muted Text: `#94a3b8`; Bright Text: `#f8fafc`; Border Color: `#334155`.
- **Functional Colors**: Success: `#10b981`; Warning: `#f59e0b`; Error: `#f43f5e`; Neutral/Inactive: `#334155`.
- **Typography**: Primary font is 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all time-stamps, IDs, and numeric values. Heading sizes: 18px bold for page titles, 14px bold for section headers, 12px for body, and 9-10px for labels/tags with 0.05em tracking.
- **Visual Effects**: Cards use a 1px solid border (`#334155`). Backgrounds feature a radial-gradient grid pattern (`rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4) 1px`, 20px spacing). Use `box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` for elevated cards. 
- **Animations**: Hover states transition over 0.2s using `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`. Active status indicators use a 2s infinite pulse animation.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling modular layout optimized for wide screens (1600px max). It transitions from high-level summaries to actionable triage items, a daily timeline view, and finally a dense comparison matrix.

prompts.prompt: Design a sticky header (height: 64px) with background `#0f172a` and a bottom border `#334155`. Left side: Logo slot with a 40px rounded-lg cyan icon container and two-tier text (Title: 18px bold; Subtitle: 10px uppercase tracking-wider). Right side: Live status pill with a pulsing emerald dot, a vertical divider, and a Mono-spaced ID badge. Include a square icon button for refresh actions.

A 4-column grid of summary cards. Each card: background `#0f172a`, 16px padding, 12px border-radius. Each card must have a 4px solid left border colored according to the status (Cyan, Rose, Indigo, Emerald). Inside, place a 40px circular icon background (10% opacity of the accent color) and stacked text: Label (10px muted) and Value (14px bold Mono).

A full-width glass-card with a header row showing item counts in color-coded badges (e.g., '3 Errors' in Rose). Content is an accordion list. Items (finding-rows) use `1e293b` on hover. Each row includes: Severity Icon, Day Tag (9px bold), Time Slot (Mono), Description (Text-muted), and a compact Cyan action button (10px bold, 4px padding-x).

A horizontal scrollable container showing a 24-hour strip. Background is the radial grid pattern. Use a vertical 2px Emerald line to represent 'NOW' with a labeled flag. Time slots are colored blocks (Cyan, Amber, or Slate-600) with thin borders. Y-axis: 4-step time markers (00, 08, 16, 24) in 9px Mono.

A dense data grid with a sticky left column for labels (e.g., Days of the Week). Each row is 80px high and split into two horizontal tracks: 'Track K' (User) and 'Track C' (Device). Use specific color blocks to indicate activity. Track K uses Cyan/Amber; Track C uses the same or a specific error state (Rose background with 'DISCONNECTED' text). A top header row provides 4-hour interval timestamps (00:00, 04:00, etc.) in 9px Mono.

special_ui_components.description: A live-data indicator used in the header and status cards.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 8px circle with a background color of `#10b981`. Apply an animation named 'pulse' that scales the shadow from `0 0 0 0 rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.7)` to `0 0 0 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0)` over a 2s duration, repeating infinitely.

special_ui_components.description: Visualizing two data sources (User vs Machine) in parallel.
special_ui_components.prompt: A container with height 80px. Split into two 40px sub-rows. Bottom sub-row has a border-top of `#334155/20`. Each track contains absolute-positioned divs representing time segments. These segments use `border-radius: 2px` and specific accent colors. Include a label 'K' and 'C' at the start of each track with 50% opacity.

structured.special_notes: Must maintain high contrast for accessibility—never use cyan text on a white background. All numeric codes must use JetBrains Mono for vertical alignment consistency. Cards must have a 1px border to distinguish them from the deep navy background. Do not use border-radii larger than 16px to keep the technical, rigid aesthetic.
